items.text: Sending our strength and prayers to President Biden, Dr. Biden and family as they navigate his treatment together. 🙏🏻

This behavior is what you would see in Russia, not in the United States of America. The Trump Administration's treatment of Senator Padilla must be called out and condemned for what it is: another step toward complete authoritarianism.

Together, we will create greater economic opportunities while protecting Californians, especially our veterans and their families, from Trump’s harmful Medicaid cuts and draconian immigration enforcement.

If you work hard in California, you should be able to afford to see a doctor or go to the hospital.

I'm determined to deliver universal healthcare coverage as California's next Governor. https://t.co/WHqdjXfr2B

I strongly support California's redistricting efforts. I'm also committed to being a Health Care Governor who brings universal coverage to our state.

That's the bold leadership required when you have a wannabe king who's cutting Medi-Cal and rigging Congress. https://t.co/dZRVEbFHgu

No Governor can lower medical costs and achieve universal coverage without building strong relationships across the entire health care system.

Local health care providers who serve patients every day are essential partners in this work. https://t.co/NWYTQe6o2i

Such an honor to receive the California Partnership for Health's first-ever endorsement in a race for Governor.

Our state needs a strong, experienced health care leader who'll protect Californians from Trump's $1 trillion Medicaid cut. https://t.co/xgg4CbEyuF

Yes I do.

While Trump cuts $1 trillion from Medicaid, I’ll be the Health Care Governor delivering universal coverage across California. https://t.co/bd41GsVOnG

Dr. Oz announced a new program that will use AI to decide whether Medicare patients can access the care they need.

What a dangerous concept.

This administration is already taking away health coverage from millions. We know we can't trust their use of AI for patient care.

Grateful to have the support of a true fighter with grit: Inland Empire leader Senator Eloise Gómez Reyes.

As Trump threatens Medi-Cal coverage, we need experienced leadership to fight back and protect Californians. https://t.co/7PMXiAq1FR

Honored to have earned the support of @JuanCarrillo4CA to become California's Health Care Governor.

Assemblymember Carrillo does some heavy lifting for families in north LA County. He’ll be an indispensable partner as we fight for universal health care coverage and lower costs. https://t.co/zbqTiR5oUt

Leucovorin is Secretary Kennedy's proposed "treatment" for autism, despite it being completely unproven.

So if this administration isn’t making decisions based on science, are they just playing politics? Or is this about enriching special interests?

Donald Trump's health care cuts are sending our rural hospitals to the brink of closure. It's putting lives at risk.

I'm running to be California's Health Care Governor to keep hospitals open and make sure our residents can access the care they need.
https://t.co/ffEgulxHIj

If I was still HHS Secretary, I never in a million years would have approved this.

Letting AI make blanket decisions about patient care is a recipe for disaster.
https://t.co/favxUCTBJM

Democrats wanted a government budget that protects Americans’ healthcare from the devastating Trump Medicaid and ACA cuts. 

Trump and Republicans said no way, no negotiations.

.@VP you inherited more Americans with health coverage than ever before and more lifesaving advancements in cancer research and disease prevention. 

You’re cutting health care for millions of Americans and canceling cancer research to pay for billionaire tax breaks.

Donald Trump has put healthcare on the ropes. More than ever, this is the time for us to support all of our nurses and healthcare professionals in California. That’s the only way we’ll keep our families healthy and safe.  

I firmly believe Kaiser and @unacuhcp nurses and healthcare professionals can finish the job of reaching a new contract that hits the mark on wages and working conditions. Here in California, we believe in collective bargaining and a fair process.

Completely unprecedented — and telling — for Americans’ distrust of our nation's top health official to be this high.

Abandon the conspiracy theories and start following the science.
https://t.co/4J189NHfOp

Happy Filipino American History Month!

From the brave Filipino veterans who fought for America in WWII to those who tirelessly fought for fair treatment of workers in the farm worker movement, Filipino Americans continue to be champions and patriots of the American story. https://t.co/AjoRJw2Bs8

Today, I was proud to join @unacuhcp nurses and healthcare professionals on the picket line.

As Californians, we believe in collective bargaining and defend workers’ rights.

Let’s stand with our healthcare professionals. It’s time for Kaiser and UNAC/UHCP to finish a new contract that improves wages and working conditions.

When I left office as HHS Secretary, a record number of Americans had health insurance. 

Now we're heading in the wrong direction because the GOP decided to hold the ACA hostage.

Premiums are going to skyrocket and many will ultimately forgo coverage. https://t.co/DIxucijZLo

Every day I served as HHS Secretary, we were laser-focused on driving down health insurance costs for the American people.

Our work led to lower premiums and a record high level of Americans with coverage.

Maybe this current administration could learn a thing or two. https://t.co/B1EF5iUzp0

Check out this article from January of this year. The record level of ACA coverage that we achieved is now under attack.

Fewer Americans will have health insurance because of the GOP's reckless premium hikes.

Reopen the government and protect our care.
https://t.co/OiF9H93f90

Americans are about to get hit hard by the GOP's premium hikes on ACA plans.

It's a major reversal from the lower premiums we achieved when I was HHS Secretary.

As California's Health Care Governor, I'll be on a mission to keep care affordable for residents of our state.

In what world can struggling families afford 30% higher premiums?

This President cares more about building a White House ballroom than he does about health care.

I'll be a Governor who protects the health care of Californians no matter what.
https://t.co/zYFiapXLL3
